purpose: Confirm that a basic highlight request adds response data which the gateway must not silently omit
environment: Separate ephemeral single-node containers with security disabled
reproduction: Start each recorded image as an isolated single-node container with its security plugin disabled.
Create highlight-probe with title mapped as text.
PUT document 1 with refresh=true and the recorded source.
POST highlight-probe/_search with the recorded request and inspect hits.hits[0].highlight.
limitations: This is a request and response compatibility probe, not a latency benchmark.
The single-document corpus verifies the presence and basic shape of highlight output, not every highlighter, analyzer, fragment, or multi-field option.
Equal snippets in this case do not establish identical highlighting semantics across Elasticsearch and OpenSearch versions.
